card.name: Science news 'More information:' and 'ability' cues
card.fires_on: The colon or word 'information' in 'More information:' and the 'Explore further' footers of science news articles. Also the word 'ability' in phrases like 'ability to swallow' or 'ability to concentrate'.

modes.label: News footer links
modes.description: The colon or 'information' in 'More information:' lines that precede a cited paper or related headline.

modes.description: The word 'ability' in label text about a patient's capacity to do something.

modes.label: Citation lead-ins
modes.description: Words or colons that introduce a journal reference, such as 'DOI:' or 'a recent issue'.
modes.example: Quarterly Journal of the Royal Meteorological Society, 2010; DOI<<:>> 10.1002

card.plain: It fires on the 'More information:' line at the end of science news stories, and on the word 'ability' in drug label text.
